svg.title: Preprocessing pipeline
svg.desc: Five sequential steps: load a VQA v2 sample, verify image-question-annotation pairing, build the answer vocabulary from training data only, encode inputs for DistilBERT and ViT, and cache the frozen-encoder embeddings. The official train and validation splits stay separate.

g.text: Start with a small sample, verify it, then scale up
Builds the answer vocabulary and trains both classifiers
